# Improvement

Propose a measurable improvement to performance, usability, maintainability, security, or operations.

Suggested title prefix: `chore: ` — Label: `enhancement`

## Current Problem

Describe the observed limitation or cost. (Required)

## Improvement Direction

Describe the proposed direction without over-specifying implementation. (Required)

## Improvement Type

Choose one: (Required)

- Performance
- Usability or accessibility
- Maintainability
- Security
- Operations

## Measurement

State the baseline, target, and measurement method. (Required)

- Current:
- Target:
- Method:

## Compatibility Impact

Choose one: (Required)

- No behavior or API change
- Minor compatible behavior or API change
- Breaking behavior or API change

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] ... (Required)

## Validation Plan

Name the exact benchmark, test, command, or manual QA action. (Required)

## Evidence

Add metrics, traces, logs, commands, screenshots, or reproduction notes. (Optional)

## Risks

Note regression, rollout, security, migration, or UX risks. (Optional)
